featured_reviews.review_text:

'Dancing is not my piece of cake, naah !' thats what used to be my perception, but today my mentor at Hadippa itself,says 'Dance is really what that has made today your identity'.
You might think that the best dancers become successful by stretching longer, doing splits, sweating a lot harder, than everyone else but that’s not the whole story. If you really want to benefit from your time training in dance, start with your mental attitude toward learning, and thats what a part of teaching of Hadippa.
Believe me this is the best world where one could live in, blessed with the best teachers, mentor and the best crowd ! ❤

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Nayak
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been attending Zumba class @Dream Dance Studio,Bhayander East since April 2022 and I am elated with the fitness goal I had set for myself and have been able to achieve.
Rahul Vats is an incredible Zumba teacher who brings a unique energy and enthusiasm to every class. I have always left feeling energized and motivated.

One thing that sets Rahul apart from other Zumba instructors is his ability to create a welcoming and inclusive environment ( I mean for non seasoned, can't dance people like me)

Rahul's choreography is always on point. His enthusiasm is infectious, and it's hard not to get caught up in the fun and energy of the class.

In addition to his excellent instruction, Rahul's playlist is always top-notch. The music is always upbeat and high-energy, which helps to keep the energy level of the class high.

His passion for Zumba is evident in every class, and you'll leave feeling not only physically invigorated but also inspired to continue dancing.

Overall, I highly recommend attending  Zumba @Dream Dance Studio.

featured_reviews.name: Jolly Correia
featured_reviews.review_text:
What began as wedding dance practices turned into some of the most special moments of my wedding journey, all thanks to Zeenia & Sabby from 567 Dance Studio ✨

We had three dances — a Bollywood mashup, our first dance, and our Bollywood first dance — and every one felt effortless, joyful, and so us. Beyond choreography, they truly showed up as the best of friends — from selecting our entry songs, helping us walk in gracefully, coordinating lights and sound, to ensuring every detail came together perfectly.

What made it even more special is that Zeenia is my childhood best friend, someone I reunited with after almost 20 years — and I honestly can’t put into words the fun, laughter, and comfort we shared during this journey. Practices were filled with late evenings, dancing, snacking, and pure happiness.

When I was at my lowest close to the wedding, they didn’t just teach — they came home, made me smile, made me dance, and lifted my spirit. And while we danced on stage, they stood off stage beaming with pride, cheering us on, like family.

Because of them, our dances became memories filled with love and meaning — and they’ve made me fall back in love with dancing. I truly can’t wait to get back to it and grow with 567 Dance Studio again.

If you’re looking for choreographers who give you more than beautiful dances — who give you heart, friendship, and unforgettable moments — this is it.

Forever Grateful ♥️
— Jolly & Keith.

I highly recommend them for any couple looking to make their wedding dance special!

We’re so incredibly grateful to Sebastian and Zeenia for creating such a magical experience for us!

What we loved most is how they made sure the choreography was uniquely “us.” Every step, every transition felt like it was telling our love story — a perfect blend of elegance, emotion, and fun that matched our vibe beautifully.

Their patience, creativity, and energy turned something we were nervous about into one of our favourite parts of the wedding journey.

Thank you for not just teaching us a dance, but for helping us create a memory we’ll cherish forever. 💛

name: Time To Dance Academy
description:
Welcome to Time to Dance Academy!
Located in [Vasai West], we specialize in a variety of dance styles, including salsa, bachata, kizomba, jive, Bollywood, hip-hop, Bharatnatyam, and hula hoop. Our experienced instructors provide personalized training for all ages and skill levels, fostering a fun and supportive environment.

Whether you're a beginner or an advanced dancer, our classes focus on technique, creativity, and confidence. We also host performances and workshops to enhance your skills and connect with fellow dancers.

Join us at Time to Dance Academy and let your passion for dance flourish! Visit [https://www.ttda.co.in/] for schedules and enrollment.

owner_posts.post_text: Discover five beginner-friendly dance styles at Time To Dance Academy — each card shows a signature technique, what you’ll learn first, and why our local instructors are trusted. Classes for all ages, with clear beginner/ intermediate breakdowns and nearby studios in Vasai, Virar and Mira Road. Ready to try a class? Call or drop by to book a free trial. 🕺💃🎯

Learn one Salsa move in 30 seconds — right here at our Vasai West studio! 💃🕺 Quick, beginner-friendly micro-lessons filmed on-site make it easy to try the step the same day. See a local student nail it, then book your first class and feel the confidence. Ready to dance in Vasai, Virar or Mira Road? Drop a comment or call to book — we’ll save your spot! 🎉

I love how Jive brings energy to every class — and you can drop in anytime. Perfect for beginners and regulars who want a fun, cardio-packed session without committing to a fixed schedule. 

• 60 or 90 minute sessions
• Drop-in friendly (max 50 participants)
• INR 300 per class

Join me at our nearby studios in Vasai, Virar or Mira Road and feel the beat. Ready to try a class? Book now or check available slots on our page!

featured_reviews.name: Winston Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text: It's been a year now and I'm love with the dance form I am learning..!! Fady & Melita have been great teachers thanks to them!!! I would suggest ttda for jive, bachata, salsa & street jazz to anyone wanting to learn these dance forms!!! Thank you ttda

featured_reviews.name: Sakhi Dhende
featured_reviews.review_text:
It is a great pleasure to be associated with TTDA and explore the unlimited opportunities to learn and enjoy the beautiful Latin dance forms. TTDA has the most humble and caring management, which helps us feel comfortable to communicate with. Their trainers are best, techniques and teaching methods are so comfortable, feels like custom made as per individual capabilities.

Love to spend time at TTDA.

featured_reviews.name: Riyana Collaco
featured_reviews.review_text: The hula-hoop classes at TTDA Academy create an exciting and energetic atmosphere for my child. The instructors are supportive and encourage each child to keep practicing, making it a fun experience that builds both skill and confidence. The class size feels just right, allowing for personalized attention, which helps my child stay engaged and feel motivated. Watching them improve and enjoy the activity so much has been incredibly rewarding.

featured_reviews.name: Taniya D'Silva
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent instructors who make it a fun experience to learn dance! I’ve been learning for the past 8 months and they definitely are the most patient instructors who go above and beyond to make learning a wholesome and inclusive experience. Definitely recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Sharon Faria
featured_reviews.review_text: TTDA has been a wonderful space for my daughter. She loves being there and has found a sense of community and belonging. The teachers are wonderful and help kids find and build their talents.

featured_reviews.name: Slavio A Correia
featured_reviews.review_text:
TTDA helped us to choreograph first dance at our wedding and they did an amazing job by fitting a dance that suited well to our song and us. The entire staff is very skilled and knowledgeable at what they do and they were extremely helpful while providing excellent attention to detail to our needs.
Our guests thoroughly enjoyed our dance and praised our moves for which I am grateful to the TTDA team especially Muriel and Nigel for their hardwork and passion. Kudos to you guys for an exceptional job! Thank you for making our big day even bigger.
